themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can perform research tasks autonomously or semi-autonomously, often involving complex workflows and tool interaction.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools and techniques that assist developers in writing, debugging, and maintaining code.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles discussing AI capabilities for condensing large amounts of text or data into concise summaries and key insights.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Explores the use of AI to create simulated users or user behaviors for testing and research purposes.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: General discussion and reviews of AI tools specifically designed to aid user researchers in various stages of the research process.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Articles focused on using AI to automate or enhance the process of testing the usability of products and interfaces.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Highlights the application of AI in augmenting or transforming the creative and analytical aspects of design and research work.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Covers AI's role in analyzing user sentiment, feedback, and emotional responses from various sources.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Focuses on the research and implications of using AI chatbots for information retrieval, assistance, and conversational interactions.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI is changing job roles, the skills required, and the overall employment landscape.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
